title: Map Studio RPC: walk
description: Walk mode (S5_BROWSER_EDITOR.md 2.10, 3.6; D7): the game's own movement controllers moving a party of the game's size over a built map. The browser's WebAssembly worker serves these (the host never forwards them: exposed false); the native core serves them too, for the contract suite's recorded walk and as the fallback lane. One walk per core (per worker, per `oymap serve`). The files are paths in the core's own file system: in the worker, the copies it fetched from the host (the built map, its <stem>.walk.yml and <stem>.walk.terrain beside it, and the asset root's decoration table). Collision is the game's; events, monsters and traps do not run; doors move only when toggled, straight to their open or shut end. The walk's yaw becomes a direction through the core's own sin and cos, so a recorded walk gives the same poses natively and in WebAssembly (`bits`).

load.summary: Reads a built map and its movement state and makes the walk: the party stands where the map starts it until walk.place. Replaces any walk this core had.

state.description: Its <stem>.walk.yml, written by the build beside it.

terrain.description: Outdoors: its <stem>.walk.terrain, written by the build beside it.

doors.description: The doors, lifts and movers walk.toggle moves (indoors), by project id, as the map starts them.

place.summary: Puts the party where an eye at that point would be (the studio's camera); the next steps let it settle on the floor as the game does.

eye.description: [x, y, z] of the eye, world units.

step.summary: Moves the party for `frames` frames of `seconds` each with the keys held and facing `yaw_radians`, as the game's frame does (an accumulator and 1/128 s movement steps); the pose after the last.

yaw_radians.description: Facing, radians from east (+x) toward north (+y).

seconds.description: The frame's length (the game caps the movement owed at 0.1 s).

frames.description: Frames of the same input (1 when absent).

replay.summary: A recorded walk: frame after frame of [yaw_radians, buttons, seconds], and at a frame `toggle` a door (before that frame). Returns the pose after the last frame and a hash of every frame's pose bits, the same in the native and the WebAssembly core.

eye.description: Where the walk starts: as walk.place.

toggles.description: Doors toggled before a frame: {frame, door}.

trace_every.description: Also return every n-th frame's pose bits (0 or absent: none).

hash.description: FNV-1a 64 of every frame's pose bits, 16 hex digits.

toggle.summary: Opens a shut door, lift or mover of the project at once, or shuts an open one: its end state as an event would leave it. Indoors only.

walk_buttons.description: The keys held, added: 1 forward, 2 back, 4 strafe left, 8 strafe right, 16 run, 32 jump.

walk_party.description: The game's party: collision radius and height, the eye over the feet, the highest step (outdoors).

landed.description: Came down during the last step.

sector.description: Indoors: the sector of the feet.

eye_sector.description: Indoors: the sector of the eye.

room.description: Indoors: the project room of that sector.

face.description: The face stood on (indoors the map's, outdoors the model's).

bits.description: x, y, feet and vertical velocity as their float bits, 8 hex digits each.
